tools.name: query_parcels
tools.description: Search US property parcels. Requires 'state' (2-letter code) plus optional 'county' (exact county name, e.g. 'Harris' or 'Harris County'), 'city' (prefix) and 'address' (prefix, e.g. '123 MAIN'). Returns parcel_id, site_address, county, state and source attribution; never owner data. Costs 1 credit

tools.name: query_permits
tools.description: Search building permits from cleared open-data sources. Requires 'state'; optional 'city', 'county', 'address' (prefix), 'permit_type', 'issued_after' / 'issued_before' (YYYY-MM-DD). Applicant and contractor personal data are stripped. Results include license and attribution per source. 1 credit per

tools.name: get_credit_balance
tools.description: Show the remaining credit balance for your API key. Free.

tools.name: list_credit_packs
tools.description: List the credit packs you can buy (name, credits, price). Free; no key needed.

tools.name: buy_credits
tools.description: Create a Stripe Checkout link to buy a credit pack (see list_credit_packs). A human must open the link and pay; this tool charges nothing. tools.name: claim_api_key
tools.description: After paying a buy_credits checkout without a key, claim the new API key with the checkout 'session_id' (starts with cs_). The key is shown only once: store it securely and send it as 'Authorization: Bearer'.

tools.name: get_fetch_job
tools.description: Check an on-demand fetch job started by query_parcels (status queued/running/done/failed). Free. When it is done, repeat the same query_parcels search.

tools.name: list_subscription_plans
tools.description: List the monthly subscription plans (name, credits per month, price). Monthly credits reset each billing cycle and do not roll over; pack credits are separate and never expire. Free; no key needed.

tools.name: subscribe
tools.description: Create a Stripe Checkout link to start a monthly plan (see list_subscription_plans). A human must open the link and pay; this tool charges nothing. tools.name: get_subscription_status
tools.description: Show your monthly plan (plan, status, renewal time, cancel_at_period_end) and your credit balances (subscription credits vs pack credits). Free.

tools.name: cancel_subscription
tools.description: Cancel your monthly plan at the end of the current paid period. No further charges; remaining monthly credits stay usable until the period ends and pack credits are kept. Free.
